abstract: INTRODUCTION: Primary teratomas of retroperitoneum are not usual in the adult population. These tumors most commonly seen at the gonadal and sacrococcygeal regions. Herein we describe a case of an 18-year-old female who had a benign cystic teratoma at the retroperitoneum. PRESENTATION OF CASE: The patient underwent an operation at another hospital following a misdiagnosis of hydatid cyst. The patient was referred to our hospital because of the detection of an unresectable tumor during her operation. A computerized tomography (CT)-angiography revealed a cystic mass, with a diameter of 14cm which was invaded into the retrohepatic suprarenal inferior vena cava and also extended to the posterior aspect of the liver. Additionally the mass invaded the posterior wall of the inferior vena cava and the right renal vein. The tumor was completely resected with a vascular resection. The inferior vena cava was reconstructed with a 12cm Dacron(®) graft and the renal vein was implanted. The patient's postoperative period was uneventful. DISCUSSION: Germ cell tumors of retroperitoneum are usually seen in children, but there are also some reports of adult cases in the literature. Adult cases are especially seen in females. Imaging studies are paramount for diagnosis, preoperative strategy and safe surgical excision. CT scans and MRIs can identify various components of these tumors. CONCLUSION: Even though primary retroperitoneal teratomas are quite rare in adults. Preoperative radiology imaging and strategy is critical for performing a safe surgery. The gold standard treatment strategy for this neoplasm is the surgical resection.
abstract_ja: 背景:成人における原発性後腹膜奇形腫は一般的ではない。これらの腫瘍は性腺部や仙尾部に最も多くみられる。症例提示:18歳女性が、他院で包虫嚢胞と誤診された後に手術を受けた。手術中に切除不能な腫瘍が発見され、当院に紹介された。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)血管造影では、直径14cmの嚢胞性腫瘤が認められ、肝後部副腎上部の下大静脈に浸潤し、肝臓の後面にも進展していた。腫瘍は下大静脈の後壁および右腎静脈にも浸潤していた。腫瘍は血管合併切除を伴い完全に切除された。下大静脈は12cmのダクロン®グラフトで再建し、右腎静脈は再吻合された。術後経過は順調であった。考察:胚細胞腫瘍は通常小児の後腹膜に発生するが、成人例の報告もある。成人例は特に女性に多い。診断、術前戦略、安全な外科的切除のためには画像検査が極めて重要である。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)および磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)でこれらの腫瘍の様々な成分を同定できる。結論:原発性後腹膜奇形腫は成人では極めて稀であるが、安全な手術のためには術前の画像診断と戦略が極めて重要である。この腫瘍の標準的な治療は外科的切除である。
